page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. It features 64 physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz, with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong performance characteristics, particularly in multi-threaded CPU execution and memory operations. The instance achieves top-tier results in stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, as well as high-throughput cached memory bandwidth read-only operations. It also exhibits strong performance in cryptographic tasks, database operations, and Redis SET operations. However, uncached memory bandwidth for large blocks and single-threaded compression tasks fall within average performance ranges.

Given its high core count and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c7a.16xlarge offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-intensive workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. It is well-suited for parallel processing tasks, multi-threaded decompression, ray tracing, image processing, and high-throughput database operations. The lack of local storage requires external block storage integration, which should be factored into the overall architectural design.
